summary: RETEST: Admin logout redirect fix verified. After login as admin@gls-douane.com -> /admin, clicking admin-logout now redirects to homepage '/' (NOT /login). Hero 'L'excellence logistique & douanière' is visible on landing. The loggingOut guard flag fix in AdminDashboard.jsx works as intended - the useEffect race condition is resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx: loggingOut guard works, but a cleaner alternative would be to call logout() then setTimeout/await before navigate, or move navigation into AuthContext.logout(). Current approach is acceptable.
Consider also clearing loggingOut on unmount to avoid stale state if component re-mounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Logout redirect to '/' verified working. Login flow at /login -> /admin also verified. Homepage hero element renders correctly after logout. Auth context properly clears token from localStorage based on observed behaviour (no redirect-back occurs).
rca of the issue: Previous iteration failed because useEffect dependency on `user` triggered before navigate('/') executed, sending user to /login when user became false. Fix: added `loggingOut` state set to true before logout(); useEffect returns early when loggingOut is true. Verified fix resolves the race condition.
